sections.title: Palaces
sections.note: Six crystals go back into the six palaces' statues; then the Great Palace opens.

items.name: Parapa Palace
items.area: North coast of the Parapa Desert
items.howTo: Go through the dark cave north of Rauru into the Parapa Desert; the palace is on its north coast. No item or spell needed.
items.reward: Candle; the crystal set in the statue (a free level-up)
items.notes: Boss: Horsehead (50 XP). Item: Candle. Zelda Wiki calls the boss Mazura. A fairy waits in the east room of the first floor.

items.name: Midoro Palace
items.howTo: After Death Mountain, break the boulders with the Hammer and walk west through the swamp from Mido. The Handy Glove inside breaks the blocks on the way to the boss.
items.reward: Handy Glove; the crystal set in the statue (a free level-up)
items.notes: Boss: Helmethead (200 XP). Item: Handy Glove. Zelda Wiki calls the boss Jermafenser.

items.name: Island Palace
items.howTo: Drop into the false grave south of the King's Tomb, then fly through the tunnel beyond it with the Fairy spell.
items.reward: Raft, in an outdoor room; the crystal set in the statue (a free level-up)
items.notes: Boss: Rebonack (300 XP). Item: Raft, in an outdoor room. StrategyWiki calls the boss the Horseback Ironknuckle.

items.name: Maze Island Palace
items.howTo: Sail the Raft from the dock south of Mido to Eastern Hyrule, go through the cave north of Nabooru, and cross the long bridge east to Maze Island. Carock and the Wizards can only be hurt with Reflect.
items.reward: Boots; the crystal set in the statue (a free level-up)
items.notes: Boss: Carock (300 XP). Item: Boots. StrategyWiki calls it the Maze Palace.

items.name: Palace on the Sea
items.area: Island in the sea east of Nabooru
items.howTo: Wear the Boots and walk east over the sea along the hidden path from the coast east of Nabooru; there is no dock for the Raft.
items.reward: Flute; the crystal set in the statue (a free level-up)
items.notes: Boss: Gooma (500 XP). Item: Flute. StrategyWiki calls it the Ocean Palace. In the Famicom Disk System version the boss is Helmethead again.

items.name: Three-Eye Rock Palace
items.area: Three-Eye Rock, on the southeast coast
items.howTo: Play the Flute to clear the River Devil south of Nabooru, then play it again in the middle of Three-Eye Rock, east of Kasuto, and the palace rises. Bring the Magic Key: there are no small keys inside. The Fairy spell reaches the boss.
items.reward: Cross, after the first Rebonack; the crystal set in the statue (a free level-up)
items.notes: Boss: Barba (700 XP). Item: Cross, after the first Rebonack. Mini-bosses: two Rebonacks. A Link Doll waits before Barba. StrategyWiki calls it the Hidden Palace.

items.name: Great Palace
items.area: Head of the Valley of Death
items.howTo: With all six crystals set, walk the Valley of Death from the graveyard south of Old Kasuto; the Cross shows its invisible Moas. Thunderbird can only be hurt after casting Thunder.
items.notes: Boss: Thunderbird (1,000 XP). Then Dark Link (Shadow Link on StrategyWiki), worth no XP. The only palace Link can enter at night; a game over inside restarts at its door. StrategyWiki calls it the Grand Palace.

items.name: Horsehead
items.howTo: At the end of Parapa Palace; the crystal statue is behind him.

items.name: Helmethead
items.howTo: At the end of Midoro Palace, past the blocks the Handy Glove breaks.

items.name: Rebonack
items.howTo: At the end of the Island Palace: an Iron Knuckle on horseback.
items.notes: The Horseback Ironknuckle on StrategyWiki. Two more Rebonacks guard the Three-Eye Rock Palace.

items.name: Carock
items.howTo: At the end of the Maze Island Palace. Only Reflect can hurt him: it bounces his beams back.

items.name: Gooma
items.howTo: At the end of the Palace on the Sea.
items.notes: NES only; the Famicom Disk System version has Helmethead here.

items.name: Barba
items.howTo: At the end of the Three-Eye Rock Palace, past the Link Doll; the Fairy spell reaches his room.

items.name: Thunderbird
items.howTo: Cast Thunder to reveal his face, his only weak spot; without it he can't be hurt.

items.name: Dark Link
items.howTo: Straight after Thunderbird, the last fight.
items.notes: Shadow Link on StrategyWiki; Link's Shadow on Zelda Wiki's boss list.
